definitions.positive_parent_family: P_v={C in F : v in C}
definitions.cross_union_width: chi_F(v)=max |A union B| over C in P_v,D in N_v; define chi_F(v)=0 if P_v or N_v is empty

lemma.statement: If chi_F(v)<=4, then the canonical exact Davis-Putnam post-formula eliminating v has maximum clause width <=4, contains no fresh variables, removes v, and is an exact existentially equivalent successor with proof-carrying model reconstruction.
proof: Every untouched clause avoids v and -v and already has width <=4.
Every non-tautological exact-DP resolvent is exactly A union B for one positive and one negative parent remainder.
The hypothesis chi_F(v)<=4 bounds every such resolvent by width 4.
Tautological resolvent deletion, canonical duplicate collapse and subsumption/minimization cannot increase width.
Exact DP eliminates v and introduces no variables, so variable rank strictly decreases by at least one and no fresh variable appears.
The existing exact-DP record plus independent replay certifies the projected formula and reconstructs a predecessor assignment from any successor assignment.
If either polarity family is empty, exact DP creates no cross-polarity resolvents and the conclusion is immediate.

hard_complement_class.name: CROSS_UNION_WIDTH5_CORE
hard_complement_class.meaning: Only this complement class needs R47J/RUP/SA_BVE width-discharge or a stronger invariant for W4 STEP coverage.

important_nonclaims: This lemma does not prove that every W4 state has a cross-union-safe pivot.
This lemma does not prove universal W4 STEP coverage.
This lemma does not prove O4 or SAT_IN_P.
This lemma does not prove P=NP or P!=NP.
